brv_employer_0.m: Ahoy kid! I am Gnossath, warden of the great dam.

brv_employer_01.m: I am waiting for Stebbarik. Have you seen him?
r: No. What do you want of him?

brv_employer_02.m: He has to work for me. I hope for his sake that he will appear soon.

brv_employer_04.m: You could do me a favor, if you'd find him for me.

brv_employer_10.m: Have you seen the lazybones, Stebbarik?
r: Stebbarik is ill at home. He is very anxious that you might get angry.

brv_employer_10_10.m: Ill? Rats! Who will repair the dam now? It must be done soon.
r: If it is so important, maybe I can help?

brv_employer_10_20.m: You? This work requires a lot of heavy lifting. You being a kid and all, I'm not sure you are up to it.

brv_employer_10_22.m: We need 25 big boulders carried from the stock to the dam here.
r: Sounds easy. Let me try it.
You are right. This is no work for me.

brv_employer_10_30.m: OK. Try, if you want. The pile of boulders is just next to the wooden logs over there.

brv_employer_10_40.m: But beware, they are really heavy.

brv_employer_30.m: Where are the boulders? I knew they would be too heavy for you.

brv_employer_40.m: You have carried some boulders already - good. Just do the rest too.

brv_employer_90.m: Thanks again for your good work. Are you sure you don't want a job?
r: Certainly not. I am on a mission for Mikhail.

brv_employee.1: The dam is very important to Brimhaven. It should be repaired.
brv_employee.10:
Stebbarik was ill at home in bed. He could not work and feared that he would lose his job. Because of his high debts, he feared that Gnossath would then take his house away.
I have offered to do the work for Stebbarik.
brv_employee.30: Gnossath has asked me to carry 25 heavy boulders from the stock to the dam.
brv_employee.40: I have carried the first boulder to the dam.
brv_employee.41: I have carried 5 boulders to the dam.
brv_employee.43: I have moved 15 boulders. This work is exhausting!
brv_employee.90: Finally - that was the last boulder! Gnossath was very pleased with my work.
